title: MnA: Variant Strength Component
description: Replaces the base MnA Strength component with one available at T2 and with effect strength controls
body:
A simple addon to Mana and Artifice.

MnA's built-in Strength spell component is Tier 4 and does not allow the application of levels beyond Strength I.

This addon replaces it with a variant that's accessible at Tier 2. Lesser Magnitude controls the status effect level, similar to other buff-applying components.
